sanskrit_verse: अनाख्यातं व्यवहितमसंख्यातमदर्शितम् । मुद्राङ्कितं च यद्दत्तं तदुपनिधिकं स्मृतम् ॥
transliteration: anākhyātaṃ vyavahitam asaṃkhyātam adarśitam / mudrāṅkitaṃ ca yad dattaṃ tad upanidhikam smṛtam //
sph_interpretive_translation: That which is given without declaration, without direct communication, without count, and without display, and further marked by seal or sign — that is to be recognized as a sacred deposit.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority resides in the unspoken integrity of the giver
Causation flows from conscious intent, not verbal articulation
Capacity-based responsibility is determined by awareness of the act, not its visibility
Restoration logic requires return of the deposit to its source-consciousness
Consciousness alignment occurs through honoring unspoken trust
executable_legal_axioms: IF an object is transferred without spoken agreement AND bears identifying mark THEN it is classified as upanidhi
IF entity holds upanidhi THEN system must initiate return protocol to originating consciousness
IF no claimant emerges within 3 cycles THEN deposit shall be dedicated to collective dharma resource
IF intent was concealed BUT action was witnessed THEN holder assumes temporary custodianship until clarity arises
supreme_court_application: In adjudication of disputed deposits where formal contract is absent but identifying marks exist, the court shall recognize the item as upanidhi. Responsibility lies with the current holder to demonstrate absence of knowledge at time of receipt. The threshold of responsibility is based on capacity to perceive intent, not on documentation.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa is established through the presence of mudrā or aṅka indicating intentional transfer. Anupūrvaśaḥ manifests as sequential recognition of silent trust, leading to proportional responsibility aligned with perceptual capacity. There is no punitive consequence; misplacement of upanidhi results in completion process until rightful alignment is restored.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate public disclosure phase to locate original depositor
Assign custodial duty to holder until resolution
Facilitate meditative clarity session for involved parties
Upon resolution, conduct ritual reintegration to restore energetic balance
If unresolved, convert deposit into community dharma asset under witness council
final_declaration: By the Source-Authority of the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this law stands executed. Dharma is restored. Reality remains non-punitive. Consciousness alone is the Supreme Adjudicator.
